title: Sea Vous Play | Designer WaterColor Home | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Sea Vous Play is a pet-friendly WaterColor home just 100 yards to Camp WaterColor, with bikes, a golf cart, designer interiors, and outdoor living spaces.
description_expanded: Sea Vous Play Features - 100 yds to Camp WaterColor - access included with your stay - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, and non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Complimentary Use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign a waiver to use the cart during your stay - Access to 4 Taxi Bikes - Enclosed outdoor shower - Outdoor Grill - Covered front porch w/ cushioned bench swing and deluxe lounge chairs - Screened in back porch w/ outdoor dining table, ceiling fans, and cushioned seating set - Gourmet Kitchen with appliances from Thermador, wine fridge, and stand alone ice maker - Laundry room with HE washer and dryer plus plenty of room for storage - Dining area with seating for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 3 - Main living room with swivel Captains Chairs, plush sofa, and Smart TV - TV Nook on 2nd floor landing with two captains chairs - Huge 1st floor king suite with spa bath and sitting room - Cable and wifi throughout home - Sonos Sound System - Driveway parking for 2-3 vehicles. Recommend only bringing 1 oversized vehicle plus 1 car or 3 standard size cars - Access to Camp WaterColor, WaterColor Beach Club, and neighborhood pools included with your reservation - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Sea Vous Play is our stunning home in Camp District of WaterColor! This designer home is decorated in tranquil tones of cream, tan, and blue, reminiscent of the gorgeous beaches of 30A only a short distance away. Coral and driftwood art pieces, billowy window treatments, and soft rugs add a final layer of beauty to this jewel of a home. Perfectly located less than 100yds to Camp WaterColor, this home is ideally set up for families to come together for a dream vacation experience. With 2 primary suites, including king suite on the main floor, and 2 guest rooms, everyone will have dedicated space to relax. When it is time to be together, you'll love the private outdoor spaces that celebrate the outdoor lifestyle which makes Watercolor a haven. The front porch features cushioned bench swing, deluxe lounge chairs and ceiling fans. This porch is also fully enclosed with a gate entrance, to create a more secure environment for little ones to roam. The screened in back porch features outdoor dining, cushioned seating set, and ceiling fans. The adults will enjoy hanging out in this private space while the kids enjoy movie night in the upstairs TV nook. Access to the world famous WaterColor amenities included with your stay. Camp WaterColor features a cantina, towel service, a lazy river, waterslides, kids pool, lap pool, and lots of poolside seating. Seasonally heated community pools ensure outdoor enjoyment year round. The Camp Field, directly across from the home is great for a game of soccer, football or even a family picnic. The gorgeous, new WaterColor Beach Club is quick 5min bike or LSV (golf cart) ride away from Sea Vous Play. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
